description: Use this when the person asks who their ideal customer is, who isn't a fit, or needs to explain who buys from them and why. Returns the account's ICP, built from what they sell: the enterprise buyers who decide, what each one is measured on and the concerns each needs answered, the signals that a company is ready to change, and who isn't a fit. If the first ICP is still being built, it says so; ask again in a minute.
name: get_icp_profile
title: Read your ideal customer profile
